body.purpose: Interface copy and dense evidence tables.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Separate one major work surface from the newsprint canvas.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and compact state changes; disabled when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Primary action for consequential workspace operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { background: #111827; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #111827; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: #374151; border-color: #374151; } .ds-btn-ink:active { background: #030712; } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #eab308; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: High-attention task action such as ingesting a boxscore.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: #eab308; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #eab308; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #ca8a04; border-color: #ca8a04; } .ds-btn-gold:active { background: #a16207; } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111827; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action that should not compete with the primary task.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f9fafb; border-color: #9ca3af; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #f3f4f6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #eab308; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact field for source URLs, search, and filters.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #4b5563; font: 600 12px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 320px; background: #fff; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #9ca3af; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #eab308; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #111827; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Direct top-level navigation for Games and Identity Queue.
components.html: VANDALS / STATS DESKGamesIdentity queue
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; background: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; color: #111827; font: 500 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-nav a { color: #6b7280; text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #111827; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #eab308; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { color: #111827; border-bottom-color: #eab308; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Textual state marker for queue and ingestion records.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #f9fafb; color: #4b5563; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font: 600 12px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #eab308; }

components.name: Evidence Table
components.css: .ds-table { width: 460px; border-collapse: collapse; background: #fff; color: #111827; font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-table th { border-bottom: 1px solid #d1d5db; padding: 8px 12px; color: #6b7280; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-align: right; } .ds-table th:first-child, .ds-table td:first-child { text-align: left; } .ds-table td { border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-table tbody tr:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #eab308; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel like the working desk behind a trusted athletics publication: compact, evidence-rich, and composed under deadline. Strong typographic hierarchy separates the game, the fact, and the source without turning routine operations into spectacle. Familiar navigation, tables, filters, and forms should disappear into the editorial task. This is an internal operations product, so density is useful when structure stays clear. Newsprint backgrounds, paper work surfaces, dark editorial ink, and a limited Vandal Gold accent create the professional confidence of ESPN or The Athletic without copying a fan-facing broadcast package.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial hierarchy with compact, repeatable data rhythms
Paper and newsprint surfaces separated by rules more often than shadows
Vandal Gold reserved for primary actions, active state, and important attention
Tabular numerals and aligned columns for fast comparison
Evidence, uncertainty, and resolution state kept beside the fact

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Vandal Gold should occupy no more than roughly 10% of a screen. Its rarity gives it editorial authority.

rules.name: The Evidence Is Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Red and green communicate status only; neither color may be used as ambient decoration, and neither may carry meaning alone.

rules.name: The Scoreboard Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Numerical comparisons use tabular numerals and right alignment; names and editorial context remain left aligned.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Tables, filters, and repeated rows use rules and tonal contrast, not stacks of floating cards.

dos: Do organize screens around an SID's editorial question, with evidence and provenance beside any fact that may be published.
Do use Paper (#ffffff), Newsprint (#f9fafb), and Newsroom Rule (#e5e7eb) to create structure before adding a shadow.
Do reserve Vandal Gold (#eab308) for primary actions, selection, focus, and important attention states.
Do use 14px body copy, 12px labels, right-aligned tabular numerals, and compact 8px to 16px row spacing for scan-friendly data.
Do provide keyboard access, visible focus, reduced-motion behavior, and status text in addition to color to meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
donts: Don't build a fan-facing athletics site around hype, promotional graphics, or game-day spectacle.
Don't produce a generic SaaS dashboard made from interchangeable cards and decorative metrics.
Don't expose a database administration console or implementation details instead of newsroom concepts.
Don't make the interface chatbot-first, obscure evidence, or treat generated prose as authoritative.
Don't imitate sports-broadcast styling when it sacrifices legibility, density, or provenance for visual drama.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, colored side stripes, ornamental display type, or animated decoration.
